fields.name: ActorTimelines
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D3B830 (ecl::timeline::ActorParticipationSystem update; registration bg3.exe+0x732270 lists the component as written, callback bg3.exe+0x75B750). For every entity of a query over a 0x20-byte component it walks an Array of 8-byte entity handles (stride 8) and inserts each handle as key (bg3.exe+0x721030) with the 8-byte handle of the query row's own entity as value (values at +0x30, stride 8, reallocated as count * 8); it then inserts a second key - the entity at +0x88 of the object returned by bg3.exe+0x13FB710 for the actor, when valid (not 0xFFC0000000000000) - with the same value. A second query over a 0xB0-byte component removes keys (swap with last, stride 8). Probe: 92 keys, capacity 128, values capacity 128.

open_questions: Key = actor entity (and its counterpart entity: dummy or original, from +0x88 of the object returned by bg3.exe+0x13FB710), value = the entity whose component listed the actor (taken to be the timeline entity). The two query component types (DAT_14631E8F8 with stride 0x20, DAT_14631E8FC with stride 0xB0) were not resolved to names, so the name ActorTimelines is a reading, not a fact.
